property_summary: For every caller and recipient and any funded amount, only calls to withdrawAll made by the contract owner can reduce the contract's balance to zero; the mutant removing the owner check allows some non-owner caller/recipient combos to drain the contract, violating this property.
change_summary: Change the access check to allow anyone to call withdrawAll (removed owner check), allowing different caller to trigger withdrawals which can affect resulting state observed via withdrawal behavior.
